body:
Founder real-time: 'idunapro needs to become truely multi tenant currently its just a fork of iduna for carepyre.' Confirmed directly: zero tenant_id anywhere, ten files hardcode carepyre by name, one process/DB/key for everyone. New docs/MULTI_TENANCY_NORTHSTAR.md names the real, sequenced plan (tenants table, tenant_id everywhere, JWT claim, per-tenant config), 3 enforcement-mechanism candidates, a 5-phase rollout. Spec-only, no code.

⚓ ☃
title: New Multi-Tenancy NORTHSTAR: IDUNA_PRO is currently just a CarePyre fork, not a real platform
